course_outline_concepts: Lee 2021 — the foundational 'dedup improves models' evidence
MinHash + LSH: Jaccard approximation, permutation count, bucket collision math
SuffixArray for long-span exact dedup; when span-level matters over document-level
Semantic dedup: SemDeDup / D4, embedding choice, cluster-level selection
When dedup helps vs hurts: aggressive semantic dedup narrows domain coverage

sources.what_to_extract: ExactSubstr (suffix array, 50-token span threshold), NearDup (MinHash 9000 sigs, b=20 bands, r=450 rows, threshold ~0.8), 3.04% near-dup tokens in C4, 61-word sentence repeated >60,000 times, 10x reduction in memorization, 4.6% LM1B / 3.2% C4 train-test overlap.
Shingles -> MinHash signature -> LSH bucketing pipeline; banding as the S-curve threshold mechanism; Broder 1997 resemblance formulation.
SemDeDup cluster-then-prune; embedding-space near-copy detection; large fractions removable with minimal loss; OOD implications.
Where hash-based dedup sits in the Common Crawl pipeline (after language ID, before quality); paragraph-hash approach.
URL dedup first (Bloom filter), paragraph dedup last; dolma-ngram threshold T=1.0; why dedup order matters with filter cascade.
Per-dump vs global MinHash ablation; counterintuitive result that global dedup hurt downstream; FineWeb-Edu classifier threshold discussion.
C4 as the uncleaned baseline dedup exposed; 61-word line as the motivating anomaly.

hard_rules: No CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Derive MinHash P(collision) = J(A,B) properly; derive r rows x b bands S-curve 1 - (1 - J^r)^b
Quote Lee 2021's eval-contamination numbers (LM1B 4.6%, C4 3.2%, Wiki-40B and RealNews entries)
